svg.title: Orchestra Process - phases 0 - 1 - 2 - 2.5 - 3 - 4 - 5 - 6a - 6b - 6c
svg.text: Contract Freeze at 2.5 unlocks 5 departments in parallel; WorkOrders pin contract hashes (Contract Epoch)
2.5 Contract and Domain Freeze - .orchestra/contract/ (Artifact Verify + human gate G6)
Stages 3-5 - five departments start in parallel after 2.5; every WorkOrder pins contract hashes (contract_refs)
Phase 6 - Delivery (Leads hand off to Platform only after 6a verified tasks)
LSP + build + tests + openapi lint + JSON Schema
staging build + docs sync (doc_debt must be empty)
G3 git push / G4 deploy - human gates
Go runtime - deterministic hooks (L5 is never a question translator)
Hub-and-spoke - org chart frozen by type, scaled by instances (frontend@web, frontend@mobile)
User manages via Orchestrator L5; dept questions reach the User through the runtime Question Barrier, not through L5 relay
Docs dept works twice: stage 1 (conventions L1 + playbooks scaffold) and 6b (project docs + ADR from decisions.md)
